entities.summary: Montenegro is a sovereign nation in Southern Europe, Europe. Its capital is Podgorica. Official languages include Montenegrin. Government: Unitary parliamentary republic. Population: approximately 0.6 million. Area: 13,812 km². Comprehensive index for Montenegro covering Illyrian/Roman Doclea, medieval Duklja/Zeta principalities, Serbian medieval kingdom influence, Ottoman conquests (never fully conquered, highland resistance), Principality/Kingdom of Montenegro (1852-1918), Petrovic-Njegos dynasty, union with Serbia (1918, Kingdom of Yugoslavia), WWII (Partisan/Chetnik divide), communist Yugoslavia, Serbia and Montenegro (2003-06), independence 2006, EU candidate, NATO member 2017.
